web/src/components/AppNotice.tsx.name: Notice strip
web/src/components/AppNotice.tsx.description: Shows a short message strip above the current screen, and keeps it visible when the person moves to another screen.

web/src/components/AuthShell.tsx.name: Sign-in page frame
web/src/components/AuthShell.tsx.description: The branded page layout around sign-in forms, with the farm's brand panel and a hint of what happens after signing in.

web/src/components/BottomNav.tsx.name: Phone bottom menu
web/src/components/BottomNav.tsx.description: The row of main navigation buttons along the bottom of the screen on a phone.

web/src/components/BrandSplash.tsx.name: Welcome splash
web/src/components/BrandSplash.tsx.description: Shows the farm's banner full-size once after each sign-in, before the person reaches the app.

web/src/components/BusyButton.tsx.name: Busy button
web/src/components/BusyButton.tsx.description: A button that turns off and shows it is working while a save is under way, so it cannot be pressed twice.

web/src/components/ConnectedApps.tsx.name: Connected apps list
web/src/components/ConnectedApps.tsx.description: Lists the outside apps a person has linked to their account, flags ones unused for a long time, and lets them disconnect one after confirming.

web/src/components/CustomerPicker.tsx.name: Customer picker
web/src/components/CustomerPicker.tsx.description: A search-and-choose box for picking a customer when recording or filtering sales.

web/src/components/DaySlots.tsx.name: Day slots
web/src/components/DaySlots.tsx.description: Draws the row of one-per-day boxes that the day strip and lay-rate bars are built on.

web/src/components/DayStrip.tsx.name: Dashboard day strip
web/src/components/DayStrip.tsx.description: The Dashboard's day-by-day lay rate strip, with a readout for the chosen day and a legend explaining the fill styles.

web/src/components/Dialog.tsx.name: Pop-up dialog
web/src/components/Dialog.tsx.description: The shared pop-up window used for forms and confirmations, which also keeps the rest of the page unreachable while it is open.

web/src/components/DialogError.tsx.name: Dialog error message
web/src/components/DialogError.tsx.description: Shows the error a pop-up raised inside that same pop-up.

web/src/components/EmptyState.tsx.name: Empty list message
web/src/components/EmptyState.tsx.description: Shown when a list or table has nothing in it: an icon, one sentence, and the main action button when there is one.

web/src/components/EntryRow.tsx.name: Entry row
web/src/components/EntryRow.tsx.description: One row of egg-count entry with plus and minus buttons, stacked to fit narrow phone dialogs.

web/src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx.name: Error catcher
web/src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx.description: Catches a screen that breaks, shows a friendly fallback with a link back to the dashboard, and recovers when the person navigates.

web/src/components/ExpandedLayRate.tsx.name: Expanded lay-rate chart
web/src/components/ExpandedLayRate.tsx.description: The larger lay-rate chart view with its own date range choices and per-day detail.

web/src/components/ExpandedRangePicker.t.name: Chart date range picker
web/src/components/ExpandedRangePicker.t.description: Lets the person choose preset or custom start and end dates for the expanded chart, up to one year.

web/src/components/FarmBrand.tsx.name: Farm name and logo
web/src/components/FarmBrand.tsx.description: Shows the farm's own name and logo, if set, in the app's header.

web/src/components/FarmDate.tsx.name: Farm date
web/src/components/FarmDate.tsx.description: Shows a calendar date in lists using the farm's chosen date format.

web/src/components/FieldConsole.tsx.name: Field console
web/src/components/FieldConsole.tsx.description: Shared styling and layout pieces for the console-style panels, including distinct looks for edit links and destructive actions like deactivate or archive.

web/src/components/FilterBar.tsx.name: Filter bar
web/src/components/FilterBar.tsx.description: The row of filter controls above a list, including a date field.

web/src/components/FlockPicker.tsx.name: Flock picker
web/src/components/FlockPicker.tsx.description: A choose-a-flock box used on capture and filter screens.

web/src/components/GlossaryLink.tsx.name: Glossary link
web/src/components/GlossaryLink.tsx.description: A small question mark next to a label that jumps to that term's explanation on the Help page.

web/src/components/GradingChip.tsx.name: Grading remainder chip
web/src/components/GradingChip.tsx.description: Shows how many eggs are still unaccounted for while grading, and lets the person hand all of them to one grade by tap or drag.

web/src/components/HenDayOver100Flag.tsx.name: Hen-day warning flag
web/src/components/HenDayOver100Flag.tsx.description: Flags a hen-day percentage above 100, which is impossible and means the egg records and bird counts disagree.

web/src/components/NamedEntityPicker.tsx.name: Search-and-pick box
web/src/components/NamedEntityPicker.tsx.description: The shared box for finding and choosing a named record such as a flock or customer, loading matches from the server as the person types.

web/src/components/namedEntityPicker/eng.name: Picker starting state
web/src/components/namedEntityPicker/eng.description: Defines the picker's working state and its starting values.

web/src/components/namedEntityPicker/Pic.name: Picker closed view
web/src/components/namedEntityPicker/Pic.description: What the pick box looks like before it is opened, showing the current choice.

web/src/components/namedEntityPicker/Pic.name: Picker open view
web/src/components/namedEntityPicker/Pic.description: The open pick box with its search field and list of matches.

web/src/components/namedEntityPicker/Pic.name: Picker dropdown panel
web/src/components/namedEntityPicker/Pic.description: The dropdown panel under the pick box, built once so typing does not make it flicker.

web/src/components/namedEntityPicker/typ.name: Picker shared types
web/src/components/namedEntityPicker/typ.description: Describes the shapes the pick box works with, including the three flock eligibility choices.

web/src/components/namedEntityPicker/use.name: Picker match loader
web/src/components/namedEntityPicker/use.description: Fetches matching records for the pick box as the person types and loads more on request.

web/src/components/namedEntityPicker/use.name: Picker selection
web/src/components/namedEntityPicker/use.description: Tracks which record the pick box has chosen and applies a new choice.

web/src/components/NumberField.tsx.name: Number field
web/src/components/NumberField.tsx.description: A number entry box made for barn use, with large steppers and friendly input handling.

web/src/components/PanelPager.tsx.name: Panel pager
web/src/components/PanelPager.tsx.description: Previous and next controls for paging through a Dashboard panel's list instead of scrolling inside it.

web/src/components/PhoneLedger.tsx.name: Phone ledger list
web/src/components/PhoneLedger.tsx.description: Compact list rows used instead of tables on phones, each with a title, a second line and a way to open details.

web/src/components/ProvenanceCell.tsx.name: Record origin note
web/src/components/ProvenanceCell.tsx.description: Shows where a record came from and whether it has been officially submitted, in a table cell or the phone details dialog.

web/src/components/SecondFactorCodeField.name: Security code field
web/src/components/SecondFactorCodeField.description: The single box for entering an authenticator or recovery code at sign-in and when confirming sensitive actions.

web/src/components/StatusBadge.tsx.name: Status badge
web/src/components/StatusBadge.tsx.description: A small coloured label showing a record's status, such as active or archived, so states read at a glance.

web/src/components/StepUpProofFields.tsx.name: Confirm-it's-you fields
web/src/components/StepUpProofFields.tsx.description: The password (and security code, when set up) fields shown before a sensitive action, with a note on who is signed in.

web/src/components/StockBar.tsx.name: Stock bar
web/src/components/StockBar.tsx.description: A stacked bar showing how much stock there is in each egg grade.
